description: Checkout at the counter: invoice in SYS-01; card payment on the P2PE terminal; ID check and release of the repaired device; daily close-out
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Nearly all revenue (about $720 per business day) is collected at release; customers expect their device back the day it is promised; RPO set by the ticketing vendor's backups (1 hour)
manual_workaround: Accept cash or check with a paper receipt and enter the payment in SYS-01 after recovery; release against the paper intake tag and photo ID; hold the device if neither works
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing and POS vendor; payment processor; internet provider

description: Bench work: diagnosis, parts ordering from suppliers, repair, testing, and quality check; about 6 tickets a day and about 25 devices in custody at any time
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Promised turnaround is same day or next day; a battery or liquid-damage repair left half done is a fire risk; ticket notes and parts orders change every hour but can be rebuilt from paper tags
manual_workaround: Repair from the paper intake tag and the printed parts list; diagnose with stand-alone tools on the bench; call customers about delays
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing and POS vendor; parts suppliers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-technician (only technician); fill-in technician about 12 days a year; repair bench

description: Counter intake: ticket creation in SYS-01; signed intake form and consent to test; intake photos; passcode collection (today in ticket notes; see P03); paper tag on the device
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Walk-ins can be written up on paper for a day or two; losing the link between a device and its owner is the real harm (integrity of custody records)
manual_workaround: Paper intake forms (pre-printed, numbered) and paper tags; enter tickets in SYS-01 after recovery

description: Copying customer data from an old device to a new one, and logical recovery from damaged devices, using the bench PC and two external transfer drives; about 260 jobs a year
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Jobs are booked days ahead and can be rescheduled; a recovered copy from a failing device may be the only copy, so the working copy has no tolerance for loss until it is delivered (RPO 0 while a job is open); exposure of customer data is a Florida breach and an FTC deception risk
manual_workaround: Reschedule jobs; for transfers, use the device makers' own direct transfer tools; no recovery jobs until the bench PC is restored
dependent_third_parties: None (all work is in the shop)

description: Status texts and emails from SYS-01; calls and texts on the business phone; website booking requests; online reviews
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers call when a promised text does not arrive; lost bookings cost a few hundred dollars a day at most
manual_workaround: Call customers from the business phone using the printed day list; post a notice on the website
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing and POS vendor; productivity suite provider; website builder; phone carrier
